notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> AZ61/route/sweep -> single-temperature ECAP -> twins (373 K) vs DRX (423/473 K) -> DSE mechanism -> YS vs passes -> down-select variable-temperature ECAP -> refined elongated grains -> EPT -> ~1 um SRX grains -> YS 330/UTS 448/15% -> above literature -> conclusion. EPT parameter windows (F7-F10) kept as side claim n24. Packet issues: F8 caption says 4-pass ECAP at 423 K but linked text says 3-pass; F9 caption says 3-pass at 473 K but text says 4-pass. F11b/F11d histograms carry OCR cue XRD (misclassified from 'Angle(deg)'). F12 as-received curve peaks ~300 MPa while text gives UTS 260 MPa. F10 (SEM) is compared by the text with F6b (OM, 10 um scale). Tables 1-4 not in packet. Audits: o7 (F15 pass-1 crossover vs text 'same pass 373 K > 423 K'), o22 (particles barely resolved in best sample F10d).
